title: 会画画的大象与夜里会飞的蝙蝠

blocks.en: Hello, young explorers, and welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! Today we meet two amazing animals: an elephant who paints pictures with her trunk, and a bat — the only mammal that can truly fly. Ready? Let's go!
blocks.title: 开场白
blocks.cn: 你好，小小探险家们，欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！今天我们要认识两种神奇的动物：一位是用鼻子画画的大象，另一位是唯一真正会飞的哺乳动物——蝙蝠。准备好了吗？出发！

blocks.en: In Thailand, in a camp in the hills near Chiang Mai, some elephants learned to paint. An elephant holds a brush with the tip of her trunk, moved by strong facial muscles, and sweeps colors across the paper. One painted a bunch of flowers, another painted a tree, and the crowd approved with loud cheers. Little by little, their paintings accumulated on the walls, and visitors loved them.
blocks.title: 会画画的大象
blocks.cn: 在泰国清迈山区的一座大象营地里，有几头大象学会了画画。大象用鼻子尖卷着画笔，在强壮的面部肌肉带动下，把颜色扫到纸上。一头画了一束花，另一头画了一棵树，观众们大声欢呼表示赞许。慢慢地，它们的画作积满了墙壁，游客们都非常喜欢。

blocks.en: The most famous work was a giant painting made by eight elephants together. It was twelve meters long — longer than a school bus! It showed the green hills and soft mist of their home, and it won a place in a book of world records. The elephants did not choose the pictures all by themselves; their trainers stood beside them and helped. Still, the paintings show the special bond between elephants and people, and how clever and gentle these giants can be.
blocks.title: 会画画的大象
blocks.cn: 最有名的一幅作品，是八头大象一起画的巨画。它有十二米长——比一辆校车还长！画的是它们家乡的青山和薄雾，还进了一本世界纪录的书。大象们并不是完全自己选画什么；驯象师站在它们身边帮忙。尽管如此，这些画展现了大象和人类之间特殊的纽带，也展现了这些庞然大物有多聪明、多温柔。

blocks.en: Meanwhile, high in the night sky, bats are waking up late, when the sun goes down. Bats are the only mammals that can truly fly. Flying squirrels can only glide, but a bat flaps its wings and stays in the air as long as it likes. Its wings are really hands: long fingers joined by thin skin, like a hand with a kite stretched between the fingers.
blocks.title: 夜里会飞的蝙蝠
blocks.cn: 与此同时，在高高的夜空中，蝙蝠们在太阳落山后醒来了。蝙蝠是唯一真正会飞的哺乳动物。鼯鼠只能滑翔，而蝙蝠扇动翅膀，想在空中待多久就待多久。它的翅膀其实是手：长长的手指之间连着薄薄的皮肤，就像手指间撑开的风筝。

blocks.en: But how does a bat fly in the dark without crashing? It uses echolocation — it calls out sounds so high that we cannot hear them, and listens for the echoes. The echoes tell it where things are: a tree, a wall, or a tasty moth. Statistics show that about one in every five mammal species in the world is a bat, and a single small bat can eat thousands of insects in one night. That is good news for farmers, and for our health, too, because fewer insects means fewer bites. Bats are not blind at all; they simply hear their way through the night. Some bats even sleep upside down, hanging by their feet all day long.
blocks.title: 夜里会飞的蝙蝠
blocks.cn: 可是，蝙蝠在黑暗中飞行怎么不撞墙呢？它用的是回声定位——发出高到我们听不见的声音，再听回声。回声会告诉它东西在哪里：一棵树、一面墙，或者一只美味的飞蛾。统计数字显示，世界上大约每五种哺乳动物中就有一种是蝙蝠，而一只小蝙蝠一夜就能吃掉几千只昆虫。这对农民是好消息，对我们的健康也有好处，因为昆虫少了，被咬的次数就少了。蝙蝠一点也不瞎；它们只是靠听觉在夜里穿行。有些蝙蝠甚至整天倒挂着睡觉，用脚挂着。

blocks.en: Here's today's idiom: 'let the cat out of the bag.' When you let the cat out of the bag, you tell a secret by mistake! Here's an example: 'Dad was cooking bacon on Sunday morning when he almost let the cat out of the bag about Mum's surprise party!' A secret is like a cat in a bag — once it leaks out, you cannot put it back. So, have you ever let the cat out of the bag?
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 今天的俚语是“let the cat out of the bag”（把猫从袋子里放出来）。当你 let the cat out of the bag 时，你就是不小心说漏了秘密！举个例子：“爸爸在周日早上煮培根的时候，差点把妈妈惊喜派对的事说漏了嘴！”秘密就像袋子里的猫——一旦漏出去，就再也塞不回来了。那么，你有没有说漏过嘴呢？

blocks.en: Let's think about our stories: elephants who paint, and bats who fly by sound. First: if you could paint with an elephant, what would you ask her to paint? Second: if you had echolocation for one night, what would you do first — catch moths, or explore a dark cave? And one last question: bats are the bosses of the night sky, so which animal would you call the boss of the day? Talk about it with your family!
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题
blocks.cn: 我们来想想今天的故事：会画画的大象，和靠声音飞行的蝙蝠。第一：如果你能和大象一起画画，你会请它画什么？第二：如果你有一夜的回声定位，你会先做什么——抓飞蛾，还是探索黑暗的洞穴？还有最后一个问题：蝙蝠是夜空的老大，那你会把哪种动物叫做白天的老大呢？和家人聊聊吧！

blocks.en: That's all for today, young explorers. Be creative like an elephant, brave like a bat — and never let the cat out of the bag! See you tomorrow!
blocks.title: 告别
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里啦，小小探险家们。像大象一样有创意，像蝙蝠一样勇敢——千万别说漏嘴！明天见！

children.text: so high that we cannot hear them
so + 形容词 + that 结果句型
：so（如此）+ high（高的）+ that（以至于）+ 结果——声音高到了我们听不见的程度。英语里 so + 形容词 + that 专门表示“如此……以至于……”的结果。
：and 把两个动词连起来，主语都是 It——蝙蝠先喊出声音，再听回声，两个动作一前一后，同一个主语不用重复。
：listen（听）+ for（为了等到）——不是随便听听，而是留神听、等着回声回来。for 在这里表示听的目的对象。
发出超声（高到听不见）→ 并列动作（喊出→听）→ 听的对象（回声）
。一句话里藏着结果句型、并列动词和动词短语三个机关。
"An elephant holds a brush with the tip of her trunk."
"It was twelve meters long — longer than a school bus!"
"Its wings are really hands: long fingers joined by thin skin."
"When you let the cat out of the bag, you tell a secret by mistake!"
D. Your own translations — there is no key for this part. Read your Chinese aloud and check that it sounds natural.
